cases.title: Repository setup identity and commit hook
cases.description: Verify the required identity and attribution controls before implementation.
steps_to_reproduce: Check Git author and committer identity and core.hooksPath.
Check hook syntax and executable permission.
Run the hook on a temporary message containing attribution and with incorrect author/committer identities.
cases.expected_result: Required owner identity; attribution removed; incorrect identities rejected; initial commit contains only the requested message.
cases.environment: Local macOS, Git CLI; Codex CLI 0.163.0

attempts.actual_result: All setup checks passed; initial commit 9ec3283 has required author and committer with no attribution.
attempts.note: Temporary hook fixtures were confined to .git and removed. No application tests exist yet.

cases.title: Repeatable migration with checksum protection
cases.description: Specification-derived migration safety checks in an isolated disposable database.
cases.expected_result: Matches the named TC in qa/test-cases.md and TRD §6.1.
cases.environment: macOS arm64; Node 24.10.0; PostgreSQL 17.11 on local Docker

attempts.actual_result: Strict lint rejected Vitest asymmetric matcher assignments and shorthand void callbacks in the integration tests.
attempts.note: Narrowed matcher values to unknown and used block callbacks; assertions unchanged.

attempts.actual_result: All eight migration integration tests passed against bidlock_migrate_test; scratch database removed afterward.
attempts.note: Includes concurrent runners, unchanged rerun, edited checksum, dry-run/status, host refusal, target selection, SQL substitution and rollback.

attempts.actual_result: Final M0 run passed: 17 unit tests, eight integration tests, lint, typecheck, guards, production build, status/dry-run, test and dev resets.
attempts.note: Foundation schema is intentionally absent until T-05; reset warns and skips environment SQL as required by T-04.

attempts.actual_result: Final T-04 PR head b2b1c27 passed static and database-tooling CI, including migration integration tests.
attempts.note: https://github.com/firatkill/bidlock/actions/runs/39565265815
